docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Texts and essays on Indian music gathered by the Bengali musicologist Sourindro Mohun Tagore (1882): the Sāmaveda, Nāradī Śikṣā, Saṅgīta Ratnākara and the rāgas.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in Cornell University Library; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Hindu music from various authors · Tagore, Sourindro Mohun, 1840-1914 · 1882, 488 scanned pages. Published 1882; Sourindro Mohun Tagore died 1914; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the machine reading of these scans is not good enough to be shown as text.
